scope: Three chats per app, two fictional text-only prompts each; 12 successful responses. Actual signed ATOM desktop and actual Codex desktop local chats, not codex exec.

pricing.kind: Standard API-equivalent estimate only; not a ChatGPT subscription invoice or quota conversion.

timing.ATOM: foreground_attempts.updated_at minus created_at, including local completion persistence; model_ms separately from turn.complete logs. UI rendering time and first visible text not measured.
timing.Codex: task_complete.duration_ms and time_to_first_token_ms from the selected desktop chat rollouts. These are host turn timings, not independently measured UI rendering.
timing.boundary_caveat: Host timing boundaries differ slightly. Do not interpret millisecond differences as UI latency differences.

methodology.concurrency: One benchmark model turn at a time; parent orchestration remains active.
methodology.settings: GPT-6 Luna, Low effort, default service tier. ATOM effort is fixed in adapter; Codex effort/model confirmed in turn_context. ATOM tier inferred from current local config; Codex tier confirmed in thread settings.
methodology.token_semantics: input is total provider input, including cached tokens. ATOM DB input excludes cache_read, so the two are added. Output includes provider-reported reasoning where any; ATOM does not separately retain reasoning usage.
methodology.tool_calls_evidence: All ATOM responses showed 0 observed calls in the UI; Codex selected rollouts contained no model function/custom/web calls.
methodology.quality: Exact replies, two bullets preserving supplied facts, one-sentence recall, Markdown table with 22 and 17, combined total 39.
methodology.context: Normal app instructions and tool catalogs retained; no project attached, no file/screen capture requested. Measures these installed configurations, not model-intrinsic efficiency. Codex prompts were submitted through desktop chat tools, with normal delegation wrappers. ATOM prompts were submitted in its native composer.
methodology.cache: Natural provider caching retained; fresh chat does not guarantee a cold provider cache.
methodology.quota_failure: One initial Codex request failed before reset and is excluded. Retried in the same first chat; the failed request remains in its history, so that chat is not a perfectly pristine first turn. No extra successful responses were generated.
methodology.ancillary: No additional per-chat usage rows were present. ATOM logged episode.failed: Conversation notes need the Claude plan, during a chat switch. No successful billed note call is represented here.
methodology.sample_limit: Six responses per app is a small descriptive snapshot; no significance, p95, long-chat, tool-workflow, or generalized quality claim.
